info.description:
Comprehensive Postman Collection with automated test assertions for Studio Fitness Booking API.
Includes automated variable propagation, dynamic pre-request scripts, and assertions for the full boutique fitness lifecycle (Auth, Studio & Class Setup, Credit Grants, FIFO Deduction, Idempotency, Class Filling, Waitlist Promotion, and Cutoff Refunds).
